EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT
This agreement is made on 03 July 2026 between Northbridge Labs Private Limited
(hereinafter referred to as the Employer) and Leela Rao (hereinafter referred to as
the Employee).
The Employee is appointed as Senior Platform Engineer. Employment will commence on 14
August 2026. This fixed-term contract ends on 13 August 2028.
The employee must give 30 days notice before resignation. If the contract is
terminated, access must be returned. This clause does not record an actual
termination.

ANNEXURE A - COMPENSATION
Employee Name: LEELA RAO
Employer: NORTHBRIDGE LABS PRIVATE LIMITED
Annual CTC: INR 24 lakh per annum
Monthly Gross: INR 180000
One-time Joining Bonus: INR 50000
Reimbursement Limit: INR 15000
The annual CTC includes variable compensation; reimbursements and the one-time
joining bonus must not be added to the stated annual CTC.
